name: play a map: load it, look around it, zoom it

steps.note: a map's name is the button that plays it; edit is the one beside it
the camera starts in the middle of the map and can be walked to an edge

steps.shot: panned to the top right corner

steps.note: arrows, the left stick and the dpad move the same camera
q and e zoom by whole steps, and stop at the ends

steps.shot: zoomed out past the edges of the map

steps.note: and so do A and B on a gamepad
already at the far end, so this one changes nothing
B is zoom out here, so it must not also leave the screen
escape goes back to the browser, and the map is untouched
the same map opens in the editor from the button next to its name
